Hi Sophie — great to hear. 16:00 CET on 23 Nov should be fine from our side; I'll loop in Camila (solutions engineer) and Markus (platform) to make sure the right folks are on the call.

A quick heads-up: we've seen forwarded invites sometimes display as "floating" or shift when recipients are in APAC (and DST can make that worse across regions this month). To avoid confusion we'll:
- Send an invite explicitly anchored to Europe/London (CET) and include the UTC time in the description.
- Attach an .ics anchored to UTC so recipients can import rather than rely on forwarded GCal messages.

Camila/Markus — can you confirm availability and whether you prefer we send the invite from my calendar or Camila's? If we send from mine I'll attach the ICS in the confirmation thread.

Thanks,

I'll be on the call and can demo the Dedicated autoscaling policy and the routing fallback flow. Markus will do a 10–15 min deep dive on the runtime choices.
